findings.title: Homepage unreachable
findings.evidence: Request error fetching https://github.com: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='github.com', port=443): Read timed out. (read timeout=5)

suggested_action.summary: Ensure the site resolves over HTTPS and responds without connection errors — an unreachable site is invisible to every crawler and AI fetcher.

findings.title: No JSON-LD structured data on the page
findings.evidence: 20/23 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://github.com/', 'https://github.com/login', 'https://github.com/features/copilot']). Zero <script type="application/ld+json"> blocks found.

suggested_action.summary: Add schema.org JSON-LD (Organization on every page at minimum; Product/Article/LocalBusiness/FAQPage where relevant) so assistants can extract facts with certainty instead of inferring them from prose.

findings.title: Page unreachable for structured-data check
findings.evidence: 3/23 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://github.com/solutions/use-case/app-modernization', 'https://github.com/solutions/use-case/devsecops', 'https://github.com/solutions/use-case/devops']). Request error: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='github.com', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /solutions/use-case/app-modernization (Caused by ConnectTimeoutError(<HTTPSConnection(host='github.com', port=443) at 0x1b348361d10>, 'Connection to github.com timed out. (connect timeout=5)'))

findings.title: Missing <title> tag
findings.evidence: 1/23 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://github.com/marketplace']). No non-empty <title> element found.

suggested_action.summary: Add a descriptive, unique <title> to every page.

findings.title: No discoverable XML sitemap
findings.evidence: /sitemap.xml returned status 406 and robots.txt has no Sitemap: line.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an XML sitemap (or sitemap index) covering canonical pages and reference it in robots.txt so crawlers can find and prioritize content efficiently.

findings.title: No Organization/LocalBusiness entity markup to anchor identity
findings.evidence: No schema.org Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD block found.

suggested_action.summary: Add an Organization JSON-LD block with name, url, logo, and sameAs — without it there is no machine-readable anchor for 'who this brand is' at all.
Improve server response time and reduce render-blocking resources — slow loads are one of the most common causes of immediate bounce.

findings.title: No contact phone or hours found in plain text
findings.evidence: 19/23 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://github.com/', 'https://github.com/login', 'https://github.com/features/copilot']). No phone-number or opening-hours pattern detected in visible text.

suggested_action.summary: If applicable to this business, state phone/hours as plain text and in LocalBusiness JSON-LD — assistants answering 'is X open now / what's their number' need this in extractable form.

findings.title: Missing meta description
findings.evidence: 1/23 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://github.com/marketplace']). No <meta name="description"> content found.

suggested_action.summary: Add a concise (~150-160 char) meta description stating what the page/brand offers — assistants and search snippets draw on this.

findings.title: No freshness/last-updated signal found
findings.evidence: No article:modified_time meta tag, visible 'last updated' text, or Last-Modified header was found.

suggested_action.summary: For time-sensitive pages (pricing, listings, events, docs) add a visible 'last updated' date and an article:modified_time meta tag so assistants can judge recency before repeating claims.

findings.title: Corroboration research not performed for this run
findings.evidence: No --search-results input was supplied, so cross-source agreement for this brand's key claims was not evaluated.

suggested_action.summary: Have the calling agent web-search 3-5 of the page's key factual claims (founding date, HQ, pricing, leadership) and re-run this check with --search-results to score corroboration.

findings.title: Incomplete Open Graph tags
findings.evidence: 4/23 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://github.com/security/advanced-security/code-security', 'https://github.com/security/advanced-security/secret-protection', 'https://github.com/marketplace']). og:title present=True, og:description present=False.

suggested_action.summary: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image so link previews and summarization tools have a clean, authoritative source to quote.

findings.title: No breadcrumb navigation detected
findings.evidence: Primary navigation is present and populated, but no breadcrumb trail (aria-label='breadcrumb' or BreadcrumbList schema) was found.

suggested_action.summary: On top of existing navigation, add a breadcrumb trail (with BreadcrumbList JSON-LD) on deeper pages — it helps both visitors and browsing agents orient within the site hierarchy, and gives assistants a clean structural signal for how pages relate.

findings.title: FAQ-shaped content found without FAQPage schema
findings.evidence: 11/23 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://github.com/features/copilot', 'https://github.com/features/codespaces', 'https://github.com/features/issues']). 74 question-style heading(s) detected (e.g. ['What is GitHub Copilot?', 'Who is eligible to access GitHub Copilot for free?']) but no FAQPage JSON-LD present.

suggested_action.summary: Mark this content up as FAQPage schema (question + acceptedAnswer pairs). It's a low-effort addition that lets assistants extract and quote Q&A pairs directly, and is exactly the kind of content AI answer engines prefer to cite verbatim.
